statement: A local tx is checked at enqueue against the planning state plus everything queued, and again at propose against the committed head. A bound on the txs of one frame and on the tokens of an Account is not here: it belongs to the transport queue (Q-T-9) and the proof body (A4). The Quint cell holds the enqueue half: a local tx is admitted against the planning state plus what is queued, not the committed state alone (queue-guard-reads-committed-only); only that half carries the id there.

killers.name: R-ADMIT a tx is checked at the door against the committed state plus everything queued
R-ADMIT a tx behind a pending frame is checked against the state that frame makes
R-ADMIT no committed tx is invalid against the history before it, in every state of the page
R-NOTICE R-ADMIT a refused tx has a conflicting predecessor in the submitted txs, in every state of the page
